name: 2-chloroaniline
description: 2-Chloroaniline (CAS 95-51-2 ), also known as o-Chloroaniline, is an aromatic amine intermediate used across dye manufacturing, agrochemical synthesis, and pharmaceutical production. It functions as a building block for constructing complex organic molecules, particularly azo dyes, pigments, and active ingredient precursors for various industrial sectors. In textile and printing industries, it serves as a key precursor in azo dye synthesis, enabling the production of colorants applied to fabric, paper, and packaging substrates. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it to synthesize active intermediates, where the ortho-chloro substitution pattern directs specific reaction pathways during API construction. In polymer and rubber processing, it acts as a curing agent and cross-linker, contributing to the structural integrity of finished elastomeric and plastic components. Agrochemical producers also rely on it as a starting material for herbicide and pesticide synthesis, where chlorinated aniline derivatives define the biological activity of the final compound. 2-Chloroaniline is supplied as a liquid at ambient conditions. It is available in technical grade for industrial synthesis applications, with higher-purity specifications offered to meet requirements. Packaging options typically range from drums to IBC containers, suited to both laboratory-scale procurement and bulk industrial supply for global chemical distribution.
